The worker then recorded the time at which a numbered ticket was called to a public desk. These limits are recorded alongside the observed 71% match rate; they do not erase the observation, but they restrict what the observation can establish.

Only supplied source bodies ground truth; actual source completeness and external pilot status were not verified.
Atom counts reflect repeated mentions and grouping choices, not independent samples.
Reasonable clearly scoped inference/recommendations are not invented errors.
